recognize_zh: 左側血液抹片可見三顆中型淋巴球，核深度分葉成花瓣狀（flower cell），染色質致密、細胞質淡藍；右側臨床照片為足跟皮膚的結痂潰瘍性病灶。花瓣狀多葉核淋巴球合併皮膚病灶，是成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤的典型組合。
features: Composite: peripheral blood smear (left) and clinical photograph of the foot (right)
Medium-sized lymphoid cells with deeply lobulated, clover-leaf/flower-shaped nuclei
Condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli; moderate pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Clinical photo shows a sharply demarcated, crusted, hyperkeratotic ulcerated plaque on the heel
Background red cells unremarkable; a platelet clump at top
describe_en: The left panel is a peripheral blood smear showing medium-sized abnormal lymphocytes with markedly polylobated, flower-like nuclei, condensed chromatin, absent nucleoli and pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm. The right panel is a clinical photograph of the heel with a well-circumscribed crusted and ulcerated skin lesion. Skin involvement is frequent in adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma. Findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma ('flower cells'), to be confirmed by CD4+ CD25+ CD7- T-cell immunophenotype and HTLV-1 serology.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform, finely convoluted nuclei rather than discrete petal-like lobes, and HTLV-1 serology is negative.
T-PLL cells have a single visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs with round or irregular nuclei, typically CD7 positive, unlike the CD7-negative lobulated ATLL cells.
Neutrophils have pink granular cytoplasm and thin chromatin bridges between lobes, whereas these cells have agranular blue cytoplasm of lymphocytes.
